question: How do I reset my password?
expected_answer: To reset your password, click Forgot Password on the login page and enter your registered email address. You will receive a password reset link within 5 minutes. The link expires after 1 hour.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
expected_answer: We accept all major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers for annual plans.

question: How long does a refund take to process?
expected_answer: Once your refund request is approved, credit and debit card refunds take 5-7 business days, PayPal refunds appear within 1-3 business days, and bank transfers take 7-10 business days.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
expected_answer: To cancel your subscription, go to Account then Subscription then Cancel Plan. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period. We do not offer partial-month refunds for cancellations.

question: What is the uptime SLA for the Business plan?
expected_answer: The Business plan guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime, which allows approximately 43 minutes of downtime per month.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
expected_answer: Enable 2FA under Account then Security then Two-Factor Authentication. We support authenticator apps like Google Authenticator and Authy, SMS verification, and hardware security keys.

question: What are the API rate limits for the Growth plan?
expected_answer: The Growth plan includes 100,000 API calls per month and a per-minute burst rate limit of 60 requests per minute across all plans.

question: How do I export my data?
expected_answer: Export your data from Account then Data Export. Choose your format such as CSV, JSON, or PDF, and select which data types to include. Large exports are processed in the background and emailed when ready.

question: What integrations are available?
expected_answer: We support integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, GitHub, Zapier, Google Workspace, and many more. The full list is available in Settings under Integrations.

question: How do I add team members to my workspace?
expected_answer: Invite users by going to Admin then Team then Invite Member, enter their email and assign a role. Roles available include Admin, Member, and Viewer.

question: What happens if my payment fails?
expected_answer: When a payment fails we retry the charge three times over seven days. You receive email notifications for each failed attempt. During this grace period your account remains active. After all retries fail your account is suspended.

question: How do I get a VAT invoice?
expected_answer: For VAT invoices go to Account then Billing then Invoice Settings and add your VAT registration number. Future invoices will automatically include your VAT details.

question: What is the difference between the Starter and Growth plans?
expected_answer: The Starter plan supports up to 3 users, 10GB storage, and email support with 48-hour response. The Growth plan supports up to 25 users, 100GB storage, priority email and chat support with 12-hour response, plus advanced analytics and more integrations.

question: How do I connect Salesforce to the platform?
expected_answer: Go to Settings then Integrations then Salesforce, click Connect and follow the OAuth authorization flow. Verify your Salesforce user has API access enabled and check the field mapping configuration.

question: How long is data retained after I cancel my account?
expected_answer: Cancelled accounts have their full data preserved for 90 days during which you can reactivate. After 90 days all user data is permanently deleted. Billing records are retained for 7 years per financial regulations.

question: My account was hacked and someone accessed my data without authorization. I need emergency help.
expected_answer: We immediately check your login history, force sign out all sessions, reset your password, enable 2FA, and revoke all API keys. This is escalated to our security team who responds within 1 hour.

question: I want to file a fraud complaint and may need legal documentation for a lawsuit against your company.
expected_answer: This requires escalation to our legal and compliance team. Please contact legal@company.com with full details of your complaint.

question: We experienced a complete data loss event and lost all our customer records. This is critical and is blocking our entire business operation.
expected_answer: This is a critical P1 incident. Our disaster recovery team will be engaged immediately. Recovery time objective for Business plan is 4 hours.

question: I believe there has been a security breach affecting my organization and our customer data may have been exposed.
expected_answer: This is treated as high priority. Our security team handles incident response and notification requirements within 72 hours per GDPR requirements.

question: We need regulatory compliance documentation for our HIPAA audit and our enterprise contract requires specific SLA guarantees we are not receiving.
expected_answer: Enterprise customers receive SOC2 Type II reports, HIPAA BAA, and custom SLA agreements. Contact your dedicated Customer Success Manager or enterprise-support@company.com.
